text: The genetic testing indicating a mutation on chromosome 9 is highly concerning and does not fit with a simple diagnosis of iron deficiency anemia. While your iron levels are low, the presence of dysplastic megakaryocytes and a specific genetic mutation suggests an underlying myeloproliferative neoplasm; have you experienced any episodes of uncontrolled bleeding or bruising?
